en.title: Range-Filtered Difference of Even and Odd Position Sums
en.description:
Given an array numbers, consider only the elements whose value lies in the closed interval [-100,100]. Compute the sum of such elements at 0-based even indices and the sum at odd indices, and output the former minus the latter.

Standard input/output and this site's supplementary ranges follow this problem's description.
en.input: The first line contains n (1≤n≤1000), and the second line contains n integers, −1000≤numbers[i]≤1000.
en.output: Output the filtered even-index sum minus the filtered odd-index sum, as one integer.
en.explanation: Scan the array once; add only the values in [-100,100] to the sum matching the parity of their index, and take the difference at the end.
